steps.content: The bizarre power of the Ash Crystal is too overwhelming, exceeding the operational limits of the currently arranged anti-Sinner combat operation.
And likewise, it's beyond what Jelena can endure.
The ominous, twisted energy overflowing from the Ash Crystal travels back through the silver chains, corrupting Jelena's body.

options: Stop it, Jelena! It's turning against you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This power is beyond what any Sinner can handle. I don't know who gave you this mission, but they never intended for you to live.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can still talk this through. Stop it!
But Jelena pays no heed to your words. Raising her hand, she pierces and enhances another drawn-in Corruptor, turning it into a new Puppet that charges forth to disperse your approaching allies.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Even now, you're still concerned about me, Chief... You must not waste your kindness on enemies anymore...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if you were to take Elvira away with you, then what?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Run away with her? But where to? You're going to keep her in the dark for your whole life? Would you even use this power in front of her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, you don't even dare to tell her who you are, what you did. If there really was a safe place to escape to, you'd have left long ago. You simply don't believe a child could grow up safely in the Outlands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know you can't protect her. The moment you decided to kill her father, you trapped yourself in an impossible dilemma. Look at what you've become! The Ash Mania is corrupting your body and your mind!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can't even protect yourself—how could I possibly entrust Elvira to you? I won't let her leave the MBCC!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I made you a promise to protect her, and now, I'm going to honor that commitment.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I'm so glad to hear those words from you...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: <size=30>Now, I can rest assured...</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What?

Before you can get an answer, a laser beam slices through, obliterating the massive Puppets. The ensuing blast propels you forcefully against the shattered walls. Were it not for a Puppet holding you just in time, you could have passed out immediately with a few ribs broken.
Glancing behind, you catch sight of a slender passage etched through the dense contamination. Across the way, a black Schorl hovers in midair.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Highest priority: reclaim <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color> and eliminate all enemies.

As you attempt to speak, multiple Puppets surge towards you, not in aggression but to shield you with their bodies. They crowd around you, muffling your voice and obscuring your sight. Trapped among them, you are pushed away from the battlefield.
[Black screen + Jelena's portrait]

Jelena confronts the inhuman adversary, showing no trace of surprise or fear. The frenzied desperation she exhibited moments ago to take Elvira back has dissipated entirely, replaced by a serene composure as she studies her opponent.

Perhaps now is the time to test how her power measures up against the great DisCity. After all, somewhere far away, in the near future, someone will need these findings. Moreover, there's no way out for her at this point.
...After all, with ${PlayerName} around, she has nothing left to worry about.
[Crystal portrait] [Background dims]
The Ash Crystal returns to her palm, slowly gathering power.
Trapped within the wall of Puppets, you hear the rain grow louder, mixed with echoes of chaos. A bone-chilling sensation suddenly seeps through your entire body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This power is something beyond that of the Apostle of Ashes. It's...
It's her children.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: To be honest, I don't like fighting.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I want to heal others, shield them, even. But this power of mine is always bound to death.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: This is where I belong, a battleground, cold to death.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I'm sorry, Chief. This is not a fair deal, but I have to force your hand, just this once...
Mania flows forth from the crystal, a power born from lives dissolved by corrupting rain, from the children of Jelena's homeland who departed this world before her, years ago.
Now, those phantoms embrace her with laughter as Jelena gradually dissolves into the downpour of Mania...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
Bang—!!
(Transition)
The bullet strikes the growing crystal, sending shrapnel flying and grazing Jelena's forehead. Though the crystal falls to the ground unscathed, its glow dims a lot.
For the Sinner has spotted the one who fired the shot.
[CG] Elvira shoots at Jelena

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: You're the one who should go...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I don't need your protection... not anymore...
The Mania levels plummet rapidly. The corrupting Mania loosens its grip on Jelena, and along with it, tears of cyan blood on the faces of the Underground Puppets fade away.
As the controlling power dissipates, the single-eye marks gradually re-emerge on some Puppets' faces. Moving slowly, they advance towards Jelena.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Mania concentration is rising near the Rust, Corruptors gathering towards here... The Underground is attempting to reclaim this Sinner?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop them!!
Blue energy converges at Schorl's core as all combat units gather on the scene. What ensues is hours of chaotic combat, with Jelena soon vanishing into the heart of the fray.
The last thing etched in your memory is of her bleeding forehead, her pale face, and that tear on her face melting away with the heavy rain.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Heh... You've grown up... It must hurt so much...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...I'm sorry, El...
